scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
They say the
famous dance school
here in Comodo is going
to open soon.
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索诺托拉]
听说克魔岛这里著名的舞蹈学校很快就要开业了。

scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
Aah...
To be a prima donna
in the spotlight!
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索诺托拉]
啊……
成为聚光灯下的首席女舞者！

scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
I want to sign up too,
but the requirements are
so specific. I wonder if
I should just try anyways...
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索诺托拉]
我也想报名，但要求太具体了。我在想是不是该直接试试看……

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Aah....
A prima donna
in the spotlight!
I'll be able to watch them become Dancers right before my eyes...!
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
啊……
聚光灯下的首席女舞者！
我就能亲眼看着她们成为舞娘了……！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
It's great to be
a man in this day and age! Hurray for the Comodo Theater!
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
生在这个时代当男人真是太棒了！克魔岛剧院万岁！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Mm?
You want
to go, too?
It's a good opportunity to watch the Dancer job change test.
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
嗯？
你也想去吗？
这是观看舞娘转职测试的好机会。

scripts.text: Go to the Job Change Area

scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
耶~~
我们走吧！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Huh...
Well, I can't
help it if you don't
want to accompany me.
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
哼……
好吧，如果你不想陪我去，我也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
One two three four,
Two two three four,
three four, three four,
one two three four.
Um?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
一二三四，
二二三四，
三四，三四，
一二三四。
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I'm sorry, but you're interrupting my practice by looking at me funny.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
抱歉，你这样奇怪地看着我，打扰到我练习了。

[艾尔]
………
……嘿，我以前是不是见过你？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Err...
That's weird, I can't remember where I've seen you.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
呃……
真奇怪，我想不起来在哪里见过你了。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
Let me know
if you have any new songs. We can always use some new music to complement our performances.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢迎~！
如果有新歌请告诉我。我们的表演总是需要新的音乐来配合。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
How are you
these days?
Do many people enjoy
your performances?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢迎~！
最近过得怎么样？
喜欢看你表演的人多吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, only authorized personnel can come here. Not just anyone can enter the Dance School.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢——嗯？
嘿，只有授权人员才能来这里。不是谁都能进入舞蹈学校的。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
If you want to watch, why don't you go to the Dance Stage in town?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
如果你想看，为什么不去镇上的舞蹈舞台呢？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
This is the
'Comodo Dance School,'
where we teach various dances from different countries. We provide entertainement for travelers from all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢迎~！
这里是“克魔岛舞蹈学校”，
我们教授来自不同国家的各种舞蹈。我们为来自世界各地的旅行者提供娱乐。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
We also provide the opportunity for aspiring Dancers to become famous throughout the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! Doesn't dancing in the spotlight sound spectacular?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我们还为有志成为舞娘的人提供在卢恩·米德加兹王国成名的机会！在聚光灯下跳舞听起来是不是很壮观？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I think it's fair to let you know that our school is selective. So we don't accept students who don't seem to have the talent to become Dancers.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我觉得有必要让你知道，我们学校是有选择性的。所以我们不接受那些看起来没有成为舞娘天赋的学生。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
What do you think?
Do you want to sign up? You only have to write a couple of things on the application, and you can just come to the lessons once or twice and try it out.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
你觉得呢？
你想报名吗？你只需要在申请表上写几样东西，然后来上一两次课试试就行了。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
So what do
you want to do~?

[Aile]
Good choice!!
Just fill out the application right there.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
选得好！！
就在那边填写申请表吧。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Your name is
{0}?
Wow! What a pretty name! Just a moment, I have to show this to the director, so come back in a little bit, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
你的名字是
{0}？
哇！多好听的名字！稍等一下，我得把这个给总监看看，过一会儿再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Mmm...
It seems that
you aren't quite qualified to enroll in our school yet. You need to be at least Job Level 40.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
嗯……
看来你还不太符合我们学校的入学资格。你需要至少达到职业等级40级。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Well, I hope
that you apply
again when you meet
the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
好吧，希望你达到要求后再来申请。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Aww~
Just think about it.
Don't forget to come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
哎呀~
再考虑考虑吧。
如果你改变主意，别忘了回来。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, this place is only for authorized personnel. If you want to sing, you should go look into being a Bard.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢——嗯？
嘿，这里只允许授权人员进入。如果你想唱歌，应该去考虑成为诗人。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Not all Archers
can become Dancers.
At least, not without some sort of sex change~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
不是所有弓箭手都能成为舞娘。
至少，不经过某种性别转换是不行的~

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Good.
Since you signed up earlier, I'll let you know some things you'll need to bring for your lessons.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
很好。
既然你之前已经报名了，我会告诉你上课需要带的一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
We're short on some supplies, but you'll be using them for yourself anyway. Just think of it as part of the tuition, so don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我们有些物资短缺，但你反正也是自己用。就把它当作学费的一部分吧，别太担心。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, you'll about ^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000 for shoe polish.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
首先，学费是^CD688910,000泽尼^000000。然后，你需要大约^CD688920个粘稠液体^000000用来擦鞋。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Then, bring ^CD68893 Jellopy^000000 and ^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 to use as ointment. And of course, you'll need a pair of ^CD6889Shoes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
然后，带上^CD68893个杰勒比结晶^000000和^CD68895瓶红色药水^000000当作药膏。当然，你还需要一双^CD6889长靴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Once again, that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000,
^CD68893 Jellopy^000000,
^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 and
^CD68891 Shoes^000000.

[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 for polishing the floor and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Boots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
首先，学费是^CD688910,000泽尼^000000。然后，带上^CD68895个蚯蚓皮^000000用来擦地板，当然还有一双^CD6889轻便鞋^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Once again that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 and 
^CD68891 Boots^000000.

[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000 for your costume, ^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000 and ^CD688920 Jellopy^000000 to treat foot injuries.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
首先，学费是^CD688910,000泽尼^000000。然后，带上^CD68892个蛤蜊外壳^000000用于服装，^CD68895瓶黄色药水^000000和^CD688920个杰勒比结晶^000000用于治疗脚部受伤。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
You'll also need to bring ^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 to make wigs for the performances and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Sandals^000000. Once again, that's...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
你还需要带上^CD688910根长发^000000用来制作表演用的假发，当然还有一双^CD6889轻便鞋^000000。再说一遍，那是……

scripts.text:
[Aile]
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000,
^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000,
^CD688920 Jellopy^000000,
^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 and
^CD6889Sandals^000000.

[Aile]
Once you've gathered everything that you need, come back so that we can begin the lessons, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
一旦你收集齐了所有需要的东西，就回来以便我们开始上课，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Oh...!
You brought
everything!
Alright then,
let me take your
tuition fee.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
哦……！
你把东西都带来了！
好吧，
让我收下你的
学费。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Next, go to ^CD6889Bijou^000000, who is in charge of the interviewing process. She will have a couple of things she'll need to ask you.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
接下来，去找负责面试流程的^CD6889碧珠^000000。她有一些问题要问你。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Mmm...?
You don't have
everything yet?
Let me remind you
so you can bring
what you need next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
嗯……？
你还没带齐
所有东西吗？
让我提醒你一下，
这样你下次可以
带上需要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Hmm...?
Are you having
trouble finding
^CD6889Bijou^000000?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
嗯……？
你找不到
^CD6889碧珠^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
You need to talk to her because she's in charge of the interviewing process. Don't worry, she should be somewhere here in the Dance School.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
你需要和她谈谈，因为她负责面试流程。别担心，她应该就在舞蹈学校的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I'll be looking
forward to a great
performance~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我很期待
精彩的表演~

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcom--Hm?
Hey, only authorized
personnel are allowed
in here.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢——嗯？
嘿，这里只允许
授权人员
进入。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
If you want to watch, be quiet and don't disturb the performers. Everyone here is busy practicing so that they can become fine Dancers.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
如果你想看，请保持安静，不要打扰表演者。这里的每个人都在忙着练习，以便成为优秀的舞娘。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
如果你还有剩余的技能点数，就无法更换职业。用完剩下的点数后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Welcome~
Ooh, a Bard! Do you have any new songs to show us? We can always use some musical accompaniment for our dances.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
欢迎~
哦，一位诗人！你有什么新歌给我们看吗？我们的舞蹈总是需要一些音乐伴奏。

[碧珠]
哎呀……！
欢迎回来~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
How are you
these days?
A lot of people
must love watching
you dance. Are you
enjoying the spotlight?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
最近过得
怎么样？
一定有很多人
喜欢看你的舞蹈吧。
你享受聚光灯吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh dear~
You seem to have traveled quite a distance to watch me perform.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哦天哪~
你似乎走了很远的路来看我表演。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I'm sorry, but I've retired. Now I'm focusing on training new Dancers. If you go to the Center Stage, you can watch my students~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
抱歉，我已经退休了。现在我专注于训练新的舞娘。如果你去中央舞台，你可以观看我的学生~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
你想成为
舞娘，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I know you're excited, but the first step is the application. Go over to the left side of the stage where Aile can help you with that.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我知道你很兴奋，但第一步是申请。去舞台左侧找艾尔，她会帮你处理。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
你想成为
舞娘，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
G-goodness!
Look at that stomach fat!
Well, it's not much, so you'll lose it in no time. Especially since I'll be handling your training~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
天哪！
看看那肚子上的肥肉！
好吧，不多，所以你很快就会减掉的。特别是因为我将负责你的训练~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Still...
The idea of the
perfect body sure
has changed since
I was young. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
不过……
完美身材的概念
自从我年轻以来
确实发生了变化。总之……

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's start
with the interview.
I'm only going to ask
a couple of simple things
so don't worry~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我们从
面试开始。
我只问几个
简单的问题，
所以别担心~

[碧珠]
好的……
我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh, you're back~
Have you studied
some more? Try to
pass this time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哦，你回来了~
你有再多学习一些吗？这次试着通过，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
1. The Dancer's dance, ^CD6889Lady Luck^000000,
increases which of the following?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 舞娘的舞蹈，^CD6889女神之吻^000000，
会增加以下哪项？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. Of the following,
which can you not consider
to be a dance?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 以下哪项
不能被视为
一种舞蹈？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
3. Which of the following
best describes a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 以下哪项
最能描述舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. Which of the following
cannot be associated with Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 以下哪项
与克魔岛无关？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. Before Comodo, what is the region name of the region NorthEast of Pharoah's Lighthouse Island?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 在克魔岛之前，法老灯塔岛东北方向的地区名称是什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. Who is the most
beautiful dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 谁是最
美丽的舞者？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
……
那是……
^660000完全错误^000000。
你没看到其他
选项吗？！
扣分……！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Of the following,
who can perform together
with a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 以下哪位
可以与舞娘
一起表演？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. Which of the following
is not a specialty of Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 以下哪项
不是克魔岛的特产？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
9. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
9. 谁是克魔岛赌场的
管理员？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
10. Who accepts the
Dancer job change
applications?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
10. 谁接受
舞娘转职
申请？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
1. What is the effect
of the combined skill,
^CD6889Mental Sensing^000000?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 组合技能
^CD6889经验值倍增^000000的效果
是什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. Which is considered
bad etiquette on the dance
floor after a dance?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 以下哪项
被认为是舞池上
舞蹈结束后的
不良礼仪？

scripts.text: Ask to dance a different dance.

[Bijou]
3. Which is not an
appropriate response
when someone makes
a mistake while you
are dancing together?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 当有人在你
一起跳舞时犯错，
以下哪项不是
适当的反应？

scripts.text: Smile at each other and continue dancing.
Ignore it if the dancer does not realize it.
scripts.translation: 如果舞者没有意识到，就忽略它。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. In which town
can you change jobs
to a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 在哪个城镇
可以转职为
舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. How many dungeons
are directly connected
to Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 有多少个地牢
直接与克魔岛
相连？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. Which of the following
is not a Cute Pet monster?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 以下哪项
不是可爱的宠物魔物？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Who is the most
graceful dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 谁是最
优雅的舞者？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
……
那是……
^660000完全错误^000000。
你没看到其他
选项吗？！
扣分……！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. What is the
exact name of the
Kafra in Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 克魔岛的
卡普拉员工的
确切名称是什么？

[碧珠]
10. ^CD6889摇篮曲^000000的
效果是什么？

scripts.text: Casts the Blind effect in the area.
Casts the Sleep effect on the area.
Puts a night effect on the area.

[Bijou]
1. What is the effect
of the skill ^CD6889Dance Lessons^000000?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 技能^CD6889练习舞蹈^000000的
效果是什么？

scripts.text: Increases the effect of dancing skills
Inflict Stun on a certain area around the caster.
scripts.translation: 对施法者周围一定区域造成眩晕。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. What dance uses shoes
that are designed to make
sound as the dancer rolls
their feet and taps the
ground to create a rhythm?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 哪种舞蹈使用的鞋子
设计目的是让舞者在滚动双脚
和敲击地面创造节奏时发出声音？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
3. Which of the following
is not a characteristic of a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 以下哪项
不是舞娘的特征？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. Which town has
the most Dancers?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 哪个城镇
的舞娘最多？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. Of the following,
who dances most beautifully?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 以下哪位
跳舞最美？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
……
那是……
^660000完全错误^000000。
你没看到其他
选项吗？！
扣分……！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. What is the Dancer
better at than the other
job classes?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 舞娘比其他
职业更擅长什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 谁是克魔岛赌场的
管理员？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. What item cannot
be equipped by a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 舞娘不能装备
以下哪种物品？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
9. Do you think you
can say this quiz is
frustrating and annoying?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
9. 你认为你能说这个测验
令人沮丧和烦人吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
10. Which of the following
is not a Jazz musician?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
10. 以下哪位
不是爵士音乐家？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Good job~
It seems like you
answered all the
questions~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
做得好~
看来你
回答了所有
问题~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
Very well done!
A perfect score!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我看看……
你的分数是
{0}分……
非常好！
满分！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
It wasn't perfect, but I'll let you pass.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我看看……
你的分数是
{0}分……
虽然不是满分，但我让你通过。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
You.. You failed!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我看看……
你的分数是
{0}分……
你……你失败了！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
There aren't too many people who apply for the Dancer job with this kind of knowledge. I'm sorry for judging you by your looks~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
拥有这种知识却申请舞娘职业的人不多。抱歉以貌取人了~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Whew~
Now you only have the Dance Test. While we prepare the test, why don't you rest a bit? Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呼~
现在你只剩下舞蹈测试了。在我们准备测试的时候，你为什么休息一下呢？呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Was it too hard?
When I was young, everyone knew at least enough to pass this test. Go and study some more before coming back, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
太难了吗？
当我年轻的时候，每个人都至少知道足以通过这个测试的知识。回去再多学习一些再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Okay...
Are you ready
for the Dance Test?
If you like, I can
explain the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
好的……
你准备好
进行舞蹈测试了吗？
如果你愿意，我可以
解释说明。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
First of all, each person gets ^CD68891 minute^000000 for the test, and everyone dances ^CD6889one at a time^000000. Don't worry if you've never danced before~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
首先，每个人有^CD68891分钟^000000的测试时间，并且每个人^CD6889单独^000000跳舞。如果你以前没跳过舞，别担心~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Once you enter the testing area, you will see the stage. First, ^CD6889change your camera angle so that it faces forward^000000. It will probably work if you ^CD6889double-click on the right mouse button^000000.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
一旦你进入测试区域，你会看到舞台。首先，^CD6889调整你的相机角度使其朝前^000000。如果^CD6889双击鼠标右键^000000，应该就可以做到。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
If you don't reset your camera angle, you may get the ^CD6889Up, Down, Left, Right^000000 commands confused.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
如果你不重置相机角度，你可能会混淆^CD6889上、下、左、右^000000的指令。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Wait for your turn in the ^CD6889waiting room^000000. If the person in front of you fails, or if it's your turn in line, your test will begin.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
在^CD6889等候室^000000等待轮到你。如果你前面的人失败了，或者轮到你了，你的测试就会开始。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
If there are a lot of people, not everyone might fit in the waiting room. If that's the case, just create an orderly line~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
如果人很多，等候室可能容纳不下所有人。如果是这种情况，只需排好队~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
When the test begins, the music will be broadcast, as well as the direction in which you should move. Just follow the instructions and move your legs.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
当测试开始时，会广播音乐以及你应该移动的方向。只需按照指示移动你的腿。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Remember, ^CD6889you will be disqualified if you don't perform the steps with the right timing^000000. Be careful, the test is very strict~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
记住，^CD6889如果你没有在正确的时机执行步骤，你将被取消资格^000000。小心点，测试非常严格~

[碧珠]
那么~
祝你好运……！！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my...
Did you
fail last time?
Don't worry, just
try to feel the rhythm~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀……
你上次
失败了吗？
别担心，只要
试着感受节奏~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
如果你还有剩余的技能点数，就无法更换职业。用完剩下的点数后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my...
I saw your
dance earlier.
You were great!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀……
我之前看了
你的舞蹈。
你很棒！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Your performance shows that you are than qualified to become a Dancer. Well then, let me change your job.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你的表现表明你完全有资格成为舞娘。好吧，让我为你更换职业。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
With the blessing of our goddess, you shall be reborn as a Dancer. From now on, no one will leave your presense without a smile~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
在我们女神的祝福下，你将重生为一名舞娘。从现在开始，没有人会在离开你面前时不带着微笑~

scripts.text:
Ooh...!
You look great
as a Dancer~
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
哦……！
你作为舞娘
看起来很棒~
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Here's a small
gift from me.
Please take it.
May your performances always bring joy to your audience~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
这是我的一份
小礼物。
请收下。
愿你的表演总是给观众带来欢乐~

scripts.text:
[Pyorgin]
Please wait in
the waiting room.
Click the Chatroom
box to enter.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥尔金]
请在
等候室等待。
点击聊天室
框进入。

scripts.text:
[Pyorgin]
Also, those who
are curious about
the test can watch
backstage.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥尔金]
另外，那些对
测试好奇的人可以在
后台观看。
